note: Predicates are the bars a future run is graded against. They are not errors observed by this workstream.

tolerances.predicate: Init, data, and Adam match crates/ferric-tensor/examples/ferromotion_mlp.rs and crates/ferric-tensor/src/optim.rs: MLP [1,32,32,1], ReLU, 48 points x=-1+2i/47, y=sin(3x), Adam lr 0.01, b1 0.9, b2 0.999, eps 1e-8, 3000 full-batch MSE steps. tolerances.in_tree_gate_note: The example asserts last < 5e-3 and max_err < 0.15 against sin(3x) only. It does not compare a second implementation and it does not record joules. The 1e-3 cross-implementation bar is preregistered here, stricter than 0.15, and is not an observed error.
